notes:
- **The picture keeps its size when the Mac switches displays.** In full screen it could stay at a quarter of its pixels.
- **A steadier, sharper stream over the internet** (with RexDesk Host 0.7.1): Wi-Fi hold-ups no longer push the bitrate to its floor, long connections carry all 60 frames a second, and the host switches to a faster way of encoding when heavy motion would cost frames.
- **Paste works beside other remote-desktop apps:** a text coming round again no longer replaces what you just copied.
- When RexDesk Host restarts, RexDesk reconnects by itself.
